headline: A 2012 executive order setting federal pay rates for 2013 under the yearly pay adjustment process.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order adjusts pay rates for certain federal jobs. Presidents issue orders like this about once a year to set the official pay tables for federal workers after any yearly raise or freeze. No summary was provided, so the exact amounts and which pay systems were changed cannot be confirmed here.

who_it_affects.how: Their official pay rates for the coming year are set or adjusted by this type of order.
Yearly pay orders often also set pay levels for top executive branch positions, though the details of this order are not given here.
